title: Hanging name sign at the entry
where: front (north) face, left of the door on the x=5 lip post: block (4,4,1) wall side facing north, or hang from the front beam at (4,5,2)
instruction: Use B.sign('spruce', ['CHASHITSU','TEA HOUSE'], {facing:'north', color:'black'}) as a wall sign on the beam face at (4,4,2) facing north; keep it clear of the lantern at (4,4,2) (move the lantern one cell to x=3 if needed).

title: Noren curtain in the doorway
where: front doorway lintel, cell (6,4,4) hanging inside the door bay, facing north (needs the beam at (6,5,3) above)
instruction: Place B.banner('blue', [['stripe_center','white'],['border','black']], {facing:'north'}) on a 1-block backing: put a stripped_spruce_log slab-width block at (6,4,5)? Simpler: banner at (6,4,4) facing north with a dark_oak_trapdoor behind at (6,4,5) closed top. Verify with mcd render --closeups.

title: Raise and widen the front gablet
instruction: Edit the roof() call in build.mjs: pediment.width 7 and pediment.pitch 1.25, keep maxHeight 4; run mcd roof base.nbt --spec <json> --dry-run first and fix every warning; re-run the lattice window loop at the end of build.mjs for the new tympanum cells.

title: Stone-grey weathering on dark tiles
instruction: mcd paint build.nbt out.nbt --rules rules.txt with 'roof -> vary textured cobbled_deepslate,deepslate_tiles'; keep only if mcd diff --fail-empty shows a visible change and it does not read busier.

title: Fuller maple crown with leaf variety
where: front-left corner, tree at x=0,z=1, crown y=4..7
instruction: Edit maple() in build.mjs: widen the crown to radius 2 on the +x side only (away from the roof), use red_wool 20% / nether_wart_block 60% / red_mushroom_block 20%, add 2 fallen-leaf carpets (red_carpet) on the grass at (2,1,0) and (3,1,1).

title: Stepping stones: staggered irregular path
instruction: In build.mjs replace the gravel cells with alternating stone_brick_slab and mossy_stone_brick_slab at ground+1, offset one cell each row so the path zig-zags from (6,1,1) steps to (9,y,0); add 2 moss_carpet tufts beside them.

title: Rear and side shrubs and a second lantern
where: back garden z=10 and east side x=12
instruction: Add a second stone lantern (copy toro()) at (11,z=10... use toro(10,10)) and 3 more azalea shrubs; add potted bamboo (potted_bamboo) on the deck corners (2,3,9) and (10,3,9).

title: Kick rail under the shoji panels
where: all four walls at y=3 inside the fence grid
instruction: In panel() in build.mjs make the y=3 backing cell stripped_spruce_log instead of snow_block so each screen has a dark lower rail; check the front elevation still shows two white rows above.

title: Roof ridge ornaments (onigawara) and a finial
where: ridge ends and top of the front gablet
instruction: Use mcd paint rules 'roof -> finial end_rod' or craft finial brush at the highest ridge cell; add dark_oak_stairs pair as ridge-end horns; stay within 9 blocks above grass (ridge top currently y=9).

title: Hanging lanterns every second eave bay
where: front and side eave beams y=5 at x=3,9 and z=6
instruction: fixture(g,{at:[x,4,z],face:'north',mount:'hang',lamp:'lantern'}) at the beam cells not yet carrying one; check mcd check shows 0 unsupported attachments.
